method: Read existing species-page mountStarterKit object literal equipmentKey; compare current HEAD diagnosis resolver. Actual product IDs use getTierProduct fallback for category x tier.
limitations: This is cross-page consistency evidence, NOT validation of biological suitability.
119 species have 113 non-null unique slugs and six null slugs.
Bell and Home hinge-back page keys are tortoise_dry_small, while page prose requires humid/forest conditions; do not blindly adopt those keys.
Obsti hirase page has no mountStarterKit key; null-slug species have no species-page source.
